homePage.title: Skip the Queue, Scan & Order
homePage.description: A revolutionary QR-based POS and inventory system. Customers scan the QR code at the table, choose their food, and completely skip the cashier line. A complete point-of-sale solution for Indonesian restaurants.

homeHowItWorks.title: How Meko Point QR Ordering Works
homeHowItWorks.description: A simple 3-step process that eliminates queues and enhances customer experience with integrated POS and inventory management
homeHowItWorks.step1Description: Customers sit at the table and scan the unique QR code with their smartphone. Instantly opens digital menu without needing to download an app.
homeHowItWorks.step2Description: Browse the complete menu with photos, descriptions, and prices. Choose food and beverages, customize orders, and easily add special requests.
homeHowItWorks.step3Description: Orders go directly to the kitchen through the POS system. Inventory automatically updates. No need to queue at the cashier. Food is delivered straight to the table.

homeWhyChooseMeko.title: Why Choose Meko?
homeWhyChooseMeko.description: Meko Point combines QR Code Ordering with Point-Of-Sale (POS) and comprehensive inventory management.
homeWhyChooseMeko.reason1Description: Customers scan table QR code to access digital menu and order directly from their phones.
homeWhyChooseMeko.reason2Description: Real-time inventory tracking with automatic stock updates when orders are created and fulfilled.
homeWhyChooseMeko.reason3Description: Access your POS system anytime, anywhere. No installation needed, automatic updates, and secure cloud storage.
homeWhyChooseMeko.reason4Description: Completely eliminate cashier queues. Orders go directly to the kitchen, reducing waiting time by up to 70%.
homeWhyChooseMeko.reason5Description: Perfect mobile experience for customers. No app download needed - works directly in web browser.
homeWhyChooseMeko.reason6Description: Track orders, inventory levels, popular items, peak hours, and revenue in real-time with comprehensive dashboard.

homeVisionMission.visionDescription: Optimizing food reservations with efficient timing, eliminating queues, and transforming how Indonesian restaurants serve their customers through innovative QR technology and comprehensive POS solutions.
